_README: Human decisions the matchers cannot make. Every entry needs a reason, because a
curated row is an assertion by a person and should be reviewable as one.
<kind>            resolves a term to exactly one entity. match_method = CURATED.
_multi_candidate  the term is real but spans MORE THAN ONE entity. It stays
NO_COUNTERPART -- the crosswalk is 1:1 by construction and a
partial mapping would silently drop half the meaning -- but the
candidates are recorded so the UI can offer them and a steward
can see what the decision was.
The build aborts if an id here is not in the entity registry, or is the wrong type.

Anantapur.reason: Same district. Andhra Pradesh adopted the Telugu transliteration 'Ananthapuramu' as the official name; 'Anantapur' remains the common English form.

Nellore.reason: Same district. Officially renamed Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore in 2008; 'Nellore' is the everyday name and the name of its headquarters city.

Vijayawada.reason: CITY, NOT A DISTRICT. Vijayawada is the headquarters of NTR district, carved out of Krishna district in 2022. Mapped so that a user who types their city still gets district-level results; the UI should show the district name, not echo the city back.

Agriculture.reason: The graph carries four overlapping agriculture sector labels (ADR-005, Industry taxonomy overlap). 'Agriculture & Allied' is the broadest and is the one Package006 and Package008 both use as a category.

Digital Services.reason: Exact concept match; the graph name carries a 'Local Entrepreneurship /' prefix from Package008's category naming.

Creator Economy.reason: Same sector under a different name. Preferred over 'Retail & Local Commerce / Creator Economy', which is a Package008 sub-category of retail rather than the sector itself.

Textile & Handloom.reason: Same sector. Handloom is a production method within textiles, not a separate industry in this taxonomy.

Local Services.reason: 'Services' is the graph's generic service-sector node and the only parent available. Broader than the idea-library sense, which is specifically neighbourhood-scale.

Web Development.reason: Same skill. Package006 qualifies it as full-stack; the onboarding form does not.

AC Repair.reason: Same trade. HVAC is the formal NSQF-aligned name for air-conditioning installation and repair.

Bike Repair.reason: Same trade. 'Two-Wheeler Mechanic' is the NSQF job role name.

Tailoring.reason: Same trade. Package006 names it by the manufacturing role rather than the craft.

Solar Installation.reason: Same skill, shorter name. Term comes from frontend/data/skills.json.

Electrical Work.reason: Domestic wiring is the default reading of an unqualified 'Electrical Work' claim on a consumer profile. 'Industrial Electrician' is a distinct, higher-NSQF skill and is deliberately NOT the target -- see _multi_candidate if this proves too narrow.

Mobile Repair.reason: Package006 has no mobile-specific skill. Electronics repair is the genuine parent, and the note in the crosswalk records that this is a broadening, not an exact match.

EV & Energy.reason: Spans three distinct industries. Mapping to 'Electric Vehicles' alone would silently drop the energy half of every idea tagged with it.

Food Business.reason: Covers both manufacturing (processing, packaging) and service (tiffin, catering, restaurants). The graph separates them.

Logistics.reason: The graph itself carries two overlapping logistics industries from different packages (ADR-005). Resolving this term requires resolving that duplication first.

AgriTech.reason: The graph has ten specific 'AgriTech: X' technology nodes but no AgriTech sector node. The sector does not exist to map to.

Women-Led.reason: Not an industry. It is a beneficiary attribute that cuts across every sector, and the idea library uses the sector field to carry it. Needs a separate dimension, not an Industry mapping.

AI Engineering.reason: One is a job role, the other a task. An unqualified 'AI Engineering' claim does not distinguish them.

Machine Operations.reason: Generic term covering at least two distinct machine skills at different NSQF levels.

Mechanical Work.reason: Package006 models mechanics by vehicle class. An unqualified claim picks neither.

Inventory Management.reason: Overlaps both, and is narrower than either.
